rendered: According to the papers, ethylene glycol (EG) does not corrode the aluminum foil during delamination. In fact, the recovered aluminum foils were fully recovered with shiny surfaces, indicating no corrosion occurred (ChemSusChem 2020, 13, 5664–5670, page 4). The XRD pattern in Figure S3 shows that all the diffraction peaks can be attributed to aluminum, indicating that the process does not corrode aluminum (ChemSusChem 2020, 13, 5664–5670, page 4). SEM images in Figure 3g and h confirmed that clean surfaces with micro-dents imprinted from NMC532 micro-particles were observed, with no transition metal elements detected through the EDX analysis (ChemSusChem 2020, 13, 5664–5670, page 4).
